about: Curated dungeon and raid entrances for the Codex (tools/lib/codex/instances.js chooseEntrance): the point on the zone map the player walks in where the instance is entered, not the client's corpse point (where a ghost returns). map: uiMapID; x, y: live (Forever) map percent. Each entry names its public source and how it was checked: the client's corpse point (should be near), our guides' gotos, warcraft.wiki.gg. Facts only. QuestieDB's Forever table stores Era-framed points for zones whose frame did not change and Forever percentages for the four that did (Stormwind City, Eastern Plaguelands, Mulgore, Redridge Mountains); every zone below either kept its frame or is one of those, so all points are live-frame.

entrances.note: The Scarab Wall gate in southern Silithus, shared with the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. Corpse point 17 yd away.
The sunken temple on the Zoram Strand, northwestern Ashenvale (warcraft.wiki.gg: The Zoram Strand). The corpse point is on the Felwood map's edge.
Blackrock Mountain from Searing Gorge, the side the client returns a ghost to (corpse point in Searing Gorge); the Burning Steppes way in is at 1428 29.4,38.3. The portal is inside the mountain.
Blackrock Mountain; the Searing Gorge way in is nearer the corpse point (204 yd against 277 yd for Burning Steppes 1428 29.4,38.3). The portal is at the top of the mountain.
Blackrock Mountain from Burning Steppes, nearer the corpse point (147 yd); the Searing Gorge way in is at 1427 34.8,85.3. Entered through Upper Blackrock Spire.

Forever. The sewer grate on Dalaran's western wall; warcraft.wiki.gg (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/City_of_Dalaran) puts the instance line and summoning stone at 8,61. The client has no corpse point.

The Defias Hideout in Moonbrook; warcraft.wiki.gg (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Deadmines) gives 42.4,72.6. The corpse point 38.2,77.5 (and our guides' 'portal inside the Moonbrook mine' goto, which copies it) is the portal deep in the mine, 200 yd away, not where one walks in.

The Dire Maul gate in the High Wilderness; past it the courtyard holds the wings' portals (North 62.5,24.9, West 60.3,30.2, East 64.8,30.2, QuestieDB lines 135-140), where the corpse point (62,33.3) lies.

Forever. Whelgar's Excavation Site; Forever's Highland Spider, Lurker and Tortoise (npcs.json 260803, 260804, 260809) are placed at 48-49,56-57 around it. warcraft.wiki.gg (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Excavation_Site:_Wetlands) gives 53.4,65.3 for the instance line, 'accessed via Whelgar's Excavation Site'; a recording settles it. The client has no corpse point.
The elevator into Gnomeregan in western Dun Morogh; warcraft.wiki.gg (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Gnomeregan) gives 24,40. The corpse point 17.7,39.2 is 327 yd west.
The Valley of Spears cave in Desolace. Corpse point 11 yd away.

Blackrock Mountain; the Searing Gorge way in is nearer the corpse point (155 yd against 283 yd for Burning Steppes 1428 29.4,38.3). The portal is at the bottom of the mountain, past Blackrock Depths' door.

The teleport spire under the necropolis in the Plaguewood (warcraft.wiki.gg, https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Naxxramas_(Classic), 'Teleport spire': 39,26 on the Era frame; Eastern Plaguelands changed frame in Forever, QuestieDB's Forever table converts it). The client has no corpse point.
Wyrmbog, southern Dustwallow Marsh. Corpse point 36 yd away.
The Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar. Corpse point 5 yd away.
Southern Barrens at the Thousand Needles border; the corpse point lies just over it on the Thousand Needles map.
Southern Barrens; the corpse point (68 yd away) lies over the border on the Thousand Needles map.
The Scarab Wall gate in southern Silithus, shared with Ahn'Qiraj Temple. Corpse point 19 yd away.

Forever. In the open ruins above the Undercity, near the way in from Brill (warcraft.wiki.gg, https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Ruins_of_Lordaeron_(instance)). QuestieDB gives Undercity map 1458 72.48,11.33; the ruins are above ground, so the point is placed on Tirisfal Glades through both maps' Forever frames. The client has no corpse point.
The monastery grounds in the Whispering Gardens, Tirisfal Glades (warcraft.wiki.gg, https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Scarlet_Monastery); Forever has one map for the four wings. Corpse point 134 yd away.
Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands. Corpse point 29 yd away.
warcraft.wiki.gg (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Shadowfang_Keep) gives 45,68. Corpse point 3 yd away.
The Stockade's door in the Mage Quarter canal, Stormwind City (Forever frame; Stormwind changed frame in Forever). Corpse point 57 yd away.

The main gate (Forever frame; Eastern Plaguelands changed frame in Forever). Corpse point 19 yd away. The service entrance is at 41.5,17.7 (objects.json's Elders' Square Service Entrance, 47.9,23.8 on the Era frame), where the Deathcharger guide's 'Stratholme Service Entrance' goto points.
The Pool of Tears, Swamp of Sorrows (warcraft.wiki.gg, https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Temple_of_Atal%27Hakkar). The corpse point 77.3,35.9 is 318 yd northeast.

Forever. Old Ironforge; Forever's zone data (zone 16919) puts quest givers Thom Filch and Afadra Dunwall 'near entrance', placed at 32-33,45-48 (npcs.json 265003, 264943). The client has no corpse point.
The front entrance at the Maker's Terrace, northern Badlands, nearer the corpse point (236 yd; it sits on the Loch Modan map's southern edge); the back entrance is at 65.2,43.5.
The cave mouth below Lushwater Oasis, the Barrens; the corpse point 47.7,35 is 199 yd northeast.
Sandsorrow Watch, northwestern Tanaris. Corpse point 9 yd away.
Northeastern Stranglethorn Vale. Corpse point 7 yd away.
